content: Criterion 0.5 stores baseline results in target/criterion/<bench-name>/<function-name>/base/ as sample.json. The --save-baseline <name> flag saves results under a named baseline in target/criterion/<bench-name>/<function-name>/<name>/. The --baseline <name> flag compares against that saved baseline without overwriting. critcmp (BurntSushi/critcmp) can export a baseline to a single JSON file via critcmp --export <name> for permanent storage outside target/. JSON baselines committed to git can be loaded via critcmp <file.json> for cross-run regression detection. The Baseline enum in criterion API allows programmatic access.
